author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
Windows can automatically install companion apps and manufacturer bloatware when you connect hardware or boot your PC.

In this video, I show you how to disable device companion apps and the Windows Platform Binary Table so companies like Razer, Logitech, LG, ASUS, and MSI cannot quietly push unnecessary software onto your system.

These tweaks can reduce background junk, improve security, and prevent manufacturer software from slowing down or interfering with Windows.
